sync.title: Offline sync
sync.body: Changes made offline wait here in order and are sent when the device is back online. Each change is sent once: a retry returns the same result. When the record changed on the web in the meantime, the latest change wins and the earlier value stays in the history.
sync.pulled: {n, plural, =0 {No record changed} one {# record changed} other {# records changed}} since the last pull · {time}

result.appliedConflict: Synced over a change made on the web: yours was later. The earlier value is kept in the history.
result.superseded: Not applied: a later change on the web wins. The record shows that change.
result.missingFields: Refused: the stage needs fields to be filled in first. Open the deal to fill them.
